# ankra_ai_board_identity (Resource)

The identity the AI board's platform-created agents act as, a singleton. The counterpart of `ankra ai board-identity provision` and `ankra ai board-identity revoke`. Without it, designated board workers escalate every ticket to a human.

The platform provisions an `operator` identity for most organisations by itself; import it (`terraform import ankra_ai_board_identity.board ai_board_identity`) rather than creating one. Provisioning never changes the role of an identity that already exists, so changing `role_slug` stands the identity down and provisions it again. Destroying it stands the identity down: the principal is kept for attribution and loses every grant above viewer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_ai_board_identity" "board" {
  role_slug = "operator"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `role_slug` (String) Built-in role the identity carries: `operator`, `member` or `viewer`. Defaults to `operator`. Changing it replaces the identity's grant.

### Read-Only

- `ankra_user_id` (String) Ankra user id of the service principal.
- `id` (String) Always `ai_board_identity`.
- `subject` (String) Subject of the service principal.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The board identity is a singleton. The platform usually provisions it, so import it.
terraform import ankra_ai_board_identity.board ai_board_identity
```
